rule.name: WeakAssertionInTest
rule.message: This check passes for almost any value: a not-null, non-empty or size-above-0 check, or a verify with only any() arguments. Assert the exact value, contents or length, such as assertEquals(List.of("a", "b"), items), and the call arguments. An exception fits only when the value cannot be pinned.
